SELECT DISTINCT sm.id, sm.redirect, sm.be_hidden, sm.menu_name, sm.priority, sm.icon, sm.parent_id, ra.req_url,sm.be_unauth FROM sys_menu sm INNER JOIN sys_resource_api ra ON sm.id = ra.resource_id AND ra.resource_type = 'MENU'
AND sm.id in
#{item}
ORDER BY sm.parent_id, sm.priority ASC

SELECT CONCAT_WS(',',m1.id,m1.parent_id,m2.parent_id,m3.parent_id,m4.parent_id,m5.parent_id,m6.parent_id) as parent_id FROM sys_menu m1 LEFT JOIN sys_menu m2 on m2.id = m1.parent_id LEFT JOIN sys_menu m3 on m3.id = m2.parent_id LEFT JOIN sys_menu m4 on m4.id = m3.parent_id LEFT JOIN sys_menu m5 on m5.id = m4.parent_id LEFT JOIN sys_menu m6 on m6.id = m5.parent_id WHERE m1.id in
#{item}
